analyst_view.overall: Brann are 6th-7th in the Conference League with 7 points and unbeaten in Europe (including 4-1 at Zalgiris), so a home win would put them close to a top-8 place. In Norway they won a wild 4-3 at KFUM on Sunday 22 Nov and host Kristiansund on 29 Nov; with little left at stake domestically, Europe should get their strongest side, though one report lists right-back Neraysho Kasanwirjo with a knee problem from that game, and their long injury list (Tronstad, Sorensen, Kjartansson and others) is already in the numbers. AGF are 24th on 2 points (one goal scored in three games) and have defender Frederik Tingager out for the rest of the autumn with a hamstring injury, which the numbers already know. No referee is named yet and news for this match was thin (fixture pages, match reports and club injury news), so the view rests on form and motivation.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals, 1.9 for Brann at home, and already count Brann's 16 goals in six and the absences of Gudmundsson and Tingager. Brann's 4-3 on Sunday fits their open style rather than adding anything new, and AGF have scored only once in three European games, so I stay at about 3.2.

corners.text: The numbers expect 11.9 corners and already add for Brann's strong recent corner count (40 in six) and cut AGF's. I found no line-up or tactical news beyond that, so I stay at about 12.

cards.text: The numbers expect 3.9 cards, 2.4 of them for AGF, and AGF's recent card rate is already counted. No referee is named yet and there is no rivalry edge between these clubs, so I stay at about 3.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.9 shots, with Brann at 18.5 and already lifted for their recent shooting and AGF's leaky defence. Brann's push for the top eight fits that picture rather than adding to it, and Kasanwirjo's knee problem (one report) is a full-back, so I stay at about 28.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.6 shots on target and already lift Brann (34 on target in six) and trim AGF (8 in three). Nothing I found changes that, so I stay at about 10.6.
